reviews.title: Great motherboards
reviews.comment: I have used Asrock motherboards for years. They are the budget brand and I have had good luck with them over the years. Always look at reviews because some models are not as reliable. I paired this board with the i3 13100T and ddr5 5600mhz ram for a slim office pc. Everything powered up and we were off to the races.
reviews.author: Evan

reviews.title: Lasted a month tops
reviews.comment: Lasted no longer than a month then started freezing up my rig intermittently and then just flat out stopped working. Fans lights but nothing else. No post no beep. And finally it stopped working completely. I checked if it was grounded properly it was I checked for bent pins there was none I checked if it supported my cpu it does and I updated the bios to ensure it did I checked my gpu and even tried through all the onboard gpu ports and my gpu I checked my ram drives cpu power supply the whole shibang. I even tried all the parts in a different rig they all worked. The board just quit. it also didn’t like memory running higher than at 2133mhz so forget xmp The bios was sorely lacking features. Very barebones. More of a nitpick but the pcie slots are right next to each other and there’s only two and there’s no u.2 slot so if you want WiFi and you have a gpu or other AIC that’s larger than a true 1 slot card you can forget about wifi connectivity. And another nitpick but probably significant to some people these days it has gigabit LAN not 2.5 LAN Also no usb c ANYWHERE it feels cheap and flimsy Has only two DIMM slots not four definitely not worth $99 More like maybe $60 at best It’s very no frills and basic. No WiFi connection. No 2.5 gigabit Ethernet crappy ram support cheap feel very few fan headers No usb c ANYWHERE Kinda slow too at least for me Says it supports i9 14th gen but I never got it to work with mine even with bios updates and a pretty decent AIO which keeps it cool in my other rig. Not worth the hassle of trying to return. It went straight in the trash!
